```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(jsonlite)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)

# 1. Read JSON file
json_data <- jsonlite::fromJSON("data/items_whale.json", simplifyVector = FALSE)
all_annotations <- if (!is.null(json_data$annotations)) json_data$annotations else list()
ojs_groups <- lapply(seq_along(json_data$items), function(i) {
  group <- json_data$items[[i]]
  raw_data <- group$data
  
  df_list <- lapply(raw_data, function(row) {
    as.data.frame(t(as.character(row)), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  })
  
  df <- do.call(rbind, df_list)
  
  timestamps <- df[[1]]
  val_df <- df[, -1, drop = FALSE]
  value_matrix <- do.call(cbind, lapply(val_df, function(col) as.numeric(col)))
  
  plot_labels <- if (!is.null(group$options$labels)) group$options$labels[-1] else group$titles
  checkbox_titles <- if (!is.null(group$titles)) group$titles else plot_labels
  
  # Filter annotations for this specific group (0-indexed match)
  group_ann <- keep(all_annotations, ~ .x$group == (i - 1))
  
  # Map into Dygraphs annotation object format
  formatted_ann <- lapply(group_ann, function(a) {
   # Convert date string to milliseconds for Dygraphs
    x_ms <- as.numeric(as.POSIXct(a$date, tz = "UTC")) * 1000
    list(
      x = x_ms,
      series = a$series,
      shortText = ifelse(!is.null(a$icon), "", "A"), # Letter/icon text
      text = a$annotation,
      icon = a$icon,
      width = 50,
      height = 25,
      cssClass = "dygraph-annotation"
    )
  })
  
  # Extract axis mapping configuration from options$series
  series_opts <- list()
  if (!is.null(group$options$series)) {
    series_opts <- group$options$series
  }
  
  list(
    index = i,                      # 1-based index (1, 2, 3, ...)
    index_zero = i - 1,             # 0-based index for JavaScript (0, 1, 2, ...)
    group_id = paste0("group_", i), # String ID (e.g., "group_1")
    title = group$title,
    titles = unlist(checkbox_titles),
    labels = unlist(plot_labels),
    colors = unlist(group$options$colors),
    dsets = unlist(group$options$sets),
    names = unlist(group$options$names),
    query = unlist(group$options$query),
    mint = unlist(group$options$minT),
    maxt = unlist(group$options$maxT),
    inst = unlist(group$options$inst),
    summary = unlist(group$options$summary),
    visibility = as.logical(unlist(group$options$visibility)),
    ylabel = group$options$ylabel,
    y2label = group$options$y2label,
    series = series_opts,
    timestamps = timestamps,
    values = value_matrix,
    strokewidth = group$options$strokeWidth,
    pointsize = group$options$pointSize,
    highlightcirclesize = group$options$highlightCircleSize,
    datewindow = group$options$dateWindow,
    xrangepad = group$options$xRangePad,
    yrangepad = group$options$yRangePad,
    rightgap = group$options$rightGap,
    annotations = formatted_ann,
    stats = group$stats
)
})
# Export all groups to OJS
ojs_define(allGroups = ojs_groups)
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

// Load local Dygraphs library
Dygraph = require(await FileAttachment("lib/dygraph/dygraph.min.js").url())

function showAnnotationModal(ann) {
  const existing = document.getElementById("dygraph-annotation-modal");
  if (existing) existing.remove();

  const backdrop = document.createElement("div");
  backdrop.id = "dygraph-annotation-backdrop";
  backdrop.style.position = "fixed";
  backdrop.style.top = "0";
  backdrop.style.left = "0";
  backdrop.style.width = "100vw";
  backdrop.style.height = "100vh";
  backdrop.style.backgroundColor = "rgba(0,0,0,0.4)";
  backdrop.style.zIndex = "9999";

  const modal = document.createElement("div");
  modal.id = "dygraph-annotation-modal";
  modal.style.position = "fixed";
  modal.style.top = "50%";
  modal.style.left = "50%";
  modal.style.transform = "translate(-50%, -50%)";
  modal.style.backgroundColor = "#ffffff";
  modal.style.padding = "20px";
  modal.style.borderRadius = "8px";
  modal.style.boxShadow = "0 4px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.3)";
  modal.style.zIndex = "10000";
  modal.style.maxWidth = "450px";
  modal.style.width = "90%";
  modal.style.fontFamily = "Arial, sans-serif";

  modal.innerHTML = `
    <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; border-bottom: 1px solid #eee; padding-bottom: 8px; margin-bottom: 12px;">
      <strong style="font-size: 16px; color: #333;">${ann.series || 'Annotation'}</strong>
      <button id="close-ann-modal" style="background: none; border: none; font-size: 22px; cursor: pointer; color: #888;">&times;</button>
    </div>
    <div style="font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.5; color: #444;">
      ${ann.text}
    </div>
  `;

  const closeModal = () => {
    modal.remove();
    backdrop.remove();
  };

  backdrop.addEventListener("click", closeModal);
  document.body.appendChild(backdrop);
  document.body.appendChild(modal);

  document.getElementById("close-ann-modal").addEventListener("click", closeModal);
}

html`${allGroups.map((group, groupIdx) => {
// the following 5 lines solve the problem of filtering and mapping when there is only one time series in a group
  const titles = Array.isArray(group.titles) ? group.titles : [group.titles];
  const visibility = Array.isArray(group.visibility) ? group.visibility : [group.visibility];
  const colors = Array.isArray(group.colors) ? group.colors : [group.colors];
  const timestamps = Array.isArray(group.timestamps) ? group.timestamps : [group.timestamps];
  const labels = [].concat(group.labels);
  
  const checkboxInputs = Inputs.checkbox(
    titles, 
    { 
      value: titles.filter((_, i) => visibility[i])
    }
  );
  
  const indinfo = Inputs.checkbox(
    titles, 
    { 
      value: titles.filter((_, i) => visibility[i])
    }
  );
  
  const legdivht = 50 + (titles.length*30);
  
  
  // Generate dynamic CSS rules to style each checkbox label & input by color
  const dynamicStyles = html`<style>
    ${colors.map((color, idx) => `
      /* Scope styles specifically to this group index */
      .group-cb-${groupIdx} label:nth-child(${idx + 1}) {
        color: ${color} !important;
        font-weight: 400;
        display: block;
      }
      .group-cb-${groupIdx} label:nth-child(${idx + 1}) input[type="checkbox"] {
        accent-color: ${color} !important;
        color: white;
      }
    `).join("")}
    #legdiv_${groupIdx} {height : ${legdivht} px;}
  </style>`;

  const chartContainer = document.createElement("div");
  chartContainer.style.width = "100%";
  chartContainer.style.height = "300px";
  chartContainer.style.position = "relative";
  chartContainer.style.marginTop = "10px";
  chartContainer.style.marginBottom = "40px";

  const chartData = timestamps.map((t, rowIdx) => {
    const row = [new Date(t)];
    for (let colIdx = 0; colIdx < labels.length; colIdx++) {
      row.push(group.values[rowIdx][colIdx]);
    }
    return row;
  });
  
  let checkedCount = checkboxInputs.value.length;
  
  checkboxInputs.addEventListener("input", () => {
    const selectedTitles = checkboxInputs.value;
    const currentVisibility = titles.map(title => selectedTitles.includes(title));
    checkedCount = selectedTitles.length;
    
    if (chartContainer._dygraphInstance) {
      chartContainer._dygraphInstance.updateOptions({ visibility: currentVisibility });
    }
  });

  requestAnimationFrame(() => {
    const initialVisibility = titles.map(title => checkboxInputs.value.includes(title));

    // Define underlay shading for Habitat Compression (Group 0)
    let underlayFn = null;
    if (groupIdx === 0 && group.stats) {
      underlayFn = function(canvas, area, g) {
// ONLY draw shading if EXACTLY ONE checkbox is selected
        if (checkedCount !== 1) return;

        const selectedTitles = checkboxInputs.value;
        const visibleIdx = titles.findIndex(t => selectedTitles.includes(t));
        
        const stats = (visibleIdx !== -1 && group.stats[visibleIdx]) ? group.stats[visibleIdx] : group.stats[2]; 
        if (!stats) return;

        const y0 = g.toDomYCoord(stats[3]);                 // Max
        const y1 = g.toDomYCoord(stats[0] + stats[1]);       // +1 SD
        const y2 = g.toDomYCoord(stats[0]);                 // Mean
        
        // Ensure y3 hits Y = 0 or the bottom of the canvas plot area (area.y + area.h)
        const y0Dom = g.toDomYCoord(0);
        const y3 = (y0Dom !== null && !isNaN(y0Dom)) ? Math.min(y0Dom, area.y + area.h) : area.y + area.h; 

        // Calculate positive heights
        const y0height = Math.max(0, y1 - y0);
        const y1height = Math.max(0, y2 - y1);
        const y2height = Math.max(0, y3 - y2); // Fills from Mean down to Y=0 / bottom

        // Draw low (green), medium (yellow), and high (red) compression bands
        canvas.fillStyle = "rgba(0, 255, 0, 0.12)";
        canvas.fillRect(area.x, y0, area.w, y0height);

        canvas.fillStyle = "rgba(255, 255, 0, 0.12)";
        canvas.fillRect(area.x, y1, area.w, y1height);

        canvas.fillStyle = "rgba(255, 0, 0, 0.12)";
        canvas.fillRect(area.x, y2, area.w, y2height);

        // Text Labels
        canvas.font = "14px Arial";
        canvas.fillStyle = "rgba(100, 100, 100, 0.85)";
        canvas.fillText("low", area.x + area.w - 60, y0 + (y0height / 2) + 5);
        canvas.fillText("medium", area.x + area.w - 60, y1 + (y1height / 2) + 5);
        canvas.fillText("high", area.x + area.w - 60, y2 + (y2height / 2) + 5);      };
    }
    const dyInstance = new Dygraph(chartContainer, chartData, {
      labels: ["Time", ...labels],
      colors: colors,
      visibility: initialVisibility,
      underlayCallback: underlayFn, // Applies underlay shading if defined
      ylabel: group.ylabel || "",
      y2label: group.y2label || "",
      series: group.series || {},  // Assigns specified series to 'y2' axis
      legend: "always",
      hideOverlayOnMouseOut: false,
      showRangeSelector: true,
      labelsSeparateLines: true,
      labelsDiv: "legdiv_"+group.index,
      strokeWidth: group.strokewidth,
      pointSize: group.pointsize,
      highlightCircleSize: group.highlightcirclesize,
      dateWindow: group.datewindow,
      xRangePad: group.xrangepad,
      yRangePad: group.yrangepad,
      rightGap: group.rightgap
    });

// Attach annotations if present for this group
  if (group.annotations && group.annotations.length > 0) {
    dyInstance.ready(() => {
      const validSeries = labels;
      
      const readyAnnotations = group.annotations.map((ann, idx) => {
        const matchedSeries = validSeries.includes(ann.series) ? ann.series : validSeries[0];
        
        return {
          x: ann.x,
          series: matchedSeries,
          shortText: ann.shortText || "A",
          text: ann.text,
          icon: ann.icon,
          width: ann.width || 20,
          height: ann.height || 20,
          cssClass: "dygraph-annotation",
          annotationId: idx // Unique reference ID
        };
      });

      dyInstance.setAnnotations(readyAnnotations);
      
      // Store reference on instance
      dyInstance._annotationList = readyAnnotations;
    });

    // Delegated click handler on the chart DOM container
    chartContainer.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
      const annEl = e.target.closest(".dygraph-annotation");
      if (annEl && dyInstance._annotationList) {
        e.stopPropagation();
        e.preventDefault();

        // Find matching annotation object from dyInstance._annotationList
        const annTitle = annEl.getAttribute("title");
        const matchedAnn = dyInstance._annotationList.find(a => a.text === annTitle) || dyInstance._annotationList[0];
        
        if (matchedAnn) {
          showAnnotationModal(matchedAnn);
        }
      }
    });
  }

    chartContainer._dygraphInstance = dyInstance;
    
    setTimeout(() => {
      chartContainer._dygraphInstance.resize();
    }, 50);
  });

  return html`
    ${dynamicStyles}
    <div id="grp${groupIdx}" class="custom-container" style="padding: 15px; background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #e9ecef; border-radius: 6px; margin-bottom: 25px;">
      <div class="custom-sidebar group-cb-${groupIdx}">
      <span class="custom-sidebar-title">Choose indicator:</span>
      ${checkboxInputs}
      </div>
      <div class="custom-main">
      <div><h3>${group.title}</h3></div>
      <div id="legdiv_${group.index}"></div>
      ${chartContainer}
      </div>
    </div>
  `;
})}`
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: 'asis'

baseurl = "https://oceanview.pfeg.noaa.gov/erddap/tabledap/"

geturl <- function(dset,fmt,query,baseurl){
  url=paste0(baseurl,dset,".",fmt, sep="")
  if(exists(query) && !is.null(query))paste0(url,"?&",query,sep="")
  return(url)
}

for (group in json_data$items) {
  ningr = 0
  for (i in seq_along(group$titles)) {
    indtitle <- group$titles[[i]]
    if(group$title=="Upwelling Index"){
      if(i>3)break
      indtitle <- substr(indtitle,1,nchar(indtitle)-5)
      }
    if(group$title=="Habitat Compression"){
      if(i>1)break
      indtitle <- substr(indtitle,1,nchar(indtitle)-9)
      }
    if(group$title=="Upwelling Index - Daily")break
    ningr=ningr+1
    if(ningr == 1)cat("#### ",group$title, "\n\n",sep="")
    clean_desc <- gsub("<[^>]+>", "", group$summary[[i]])
      title = indtitle
      description = trimws(clean_desc)
      institution = group$inst[[i]]
      trange = paste0(substr(group$minT[[i]],1,10)," - ",substr(group$maxT[[i]],1,10),sep="")
    csv = geturl(group$dsets[[i]],'csv',group$query[[i]],baseurl)
    html = geturl(group$dsets[[i]],'html',group$query[[i]],baseurl)
    
    cat("**",title,"**\n",sep="")
    cat(description,"\n\n",sep="")
    cat("*Institution*: ",institution,"\n\n",sep="")
    cat("*Time Range:* ", trange,"\n\n",sep="")
    cat("*Download:*&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;  [csv file](",csv,")&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;","[Go to ERDDAP&#8482;](", html,")\n\n" ,sep="") 
   }
}
```

```{r}
#| echo: false

library(sf)
library(leaflet)
library(leaflet.extras)
library(jsonlite)
library(htmltools)

# Read Data
geo_data <- st_read("data/items_map.json", quiet = TRUE)

# Fix geometry/CRS if needed
st_crs(geo_data) <- 4326

# Define Species Color Map
species_colors <- c(
  "Gray Whale"          = "#8f8f8f",
  "Humpback Whale"      = "#4da82b",
  "Blue Whale"           = "#1f96a8",
  "Fin Whale"            = "#ff7800",
  "Killer Whale"         = "#eeeeee",
  "Minke Whale"          = "#ffff00",
  "Sperm Whale"          = "#9933ff",
  "Bryde's Whale"        = "#ff55a3",
  "Unidentified Whale"   = "#c2291b"
)

add_custom_legend <- function(map) {
  legend_html <- HTML('
    <div class="custom-species-legend">
      <div style="font-weight: bold; margin-bottom: 3px; text-align: center;">Legend</div>
      
      <!-- Status circles on the same line -->
      <div style="display: flex; gap: 15px; justify-content: center; align-items: center; margin-bottom: 3px;">
        <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px;">
          <span style="display: inline-block; width: 14px; height: 14px; border: 2px solid #ffffff; border-radius: 50%;"></span>
          <span>Alive</span>
        </div>
        <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px;">
          <span style="display: inline-block; width: 14px; height: 14px; border: 2px solid #000000; border-radius: 50%;"></span>
          <span>Dead</span>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 3px;">
        <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;"><span style="display: inline-block; width: 12px; height: 12px; background-color: #8f8f8f; border-radius: 50%;"></span> Gray Whale</div>
        <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;"><span style="display: inline-block; width: 12px; height: 12px; background-color: #4da82b; border-radius: 50%;"></span> Humpback Whale</div>
        <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;"><span style="display: inline-block; width: 12px; height: 12px; background-color: #1f96a8; border-radius: 50%;"></span> Blue Whale</div>
        <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;"><span style="display: inline-block; width: 12px; height: 12px; background-color: #ff7800; border-radius: 50%;"></span> Fin Whale</div>
        <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;"><span style="display: inline-block; width: 12px; height: 12px; background-color: #eeeeee; border-radius: 50%;"></span> Killer Whale</div>
        <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;"><span style="display: inline-block; width: 12px; height: 12px; background-color: #ffff00; border-radius: 50%;"></span> Minke Whale</div>
        <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;"><span style="display: inline-block; width: 12px; height: 12px; background-color: #9933ff; border-radius: 50%;"></span> Sperm Whale</div>
        <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;"><span style="display: inline-block; width: 12px; height: 12px; background-color: #ff55a3; border-radius: 50%;"></span> Bryde\'s Whale</div>
        <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;"><span style="display: inline-block; width: 12px; height: 12px; background-color: #c2291b; border-radius: 50%;"></span> Unidentified Whale</div>
      </div>
    </div>
  ')

  map %>% addControl(html = legend_html, position = "bottomleft")
}

# Add Custom Properties for Leaflet Styling
geo_data$fill_color <- species_colors[geo_data$Common_Name]
geo_data$fill_color[is.na(geo_data$fill_color)] <- "#c2291b" # Default fallback

# Border color based on Alive/Dead status
geo_data$border_color <- ifelse(tolower(geo_data$Alive_Dead) == "dead", "#000000", "#ffffff")

# Generate HTML Popup Content
geo_data$popup_html <- sprintf(
  "<p><b>%s</b><br>
  <b>Date:</b> %s<br>
  <b>Case ID:</b> %s<br>
  <b>Report County:</b> %s<br>
  <b>State:</b> %s<br>
  <b>Alive or Dead?:</b> %s<br>
  <b>Entanglement Type:</b> %s<br>
  <b>Entanglement Fishery:</b> %s<br>
  <b>Entanglement Fishery Code:</b> %s<br>
  <b>Entanglement Response:</b> %s<br>
  <b>Entanglement Removed:</b> %s</p>",
  htmlEscape(geo_data$Common_Name),
  htmlEscape(geo_data$time),
  htmlEscape(geo_data$CaseID),
  htmlEscape(geo_data$Report_County),
  htmlEscape(geo_data$State),
  htmlEscape(geo_data$Alive_Dead),
  htmlEscape(geo_data$Entanglement_Type),
  htmlEscape(geo_data$Entanglement_Fishery),
  htmlEscape(geo_data$Entanglement_Fishery_Code),
  htmlEscape(geo_data$Entanglement_Response),
  htmlEscape(geo_data$Entanglement_Removed)
)

# Build Base Leaflet Map
m <- leaflet(height = "800px",width="800px") %>%
  addProviderTiles(providers$USGS.USImagery, group = "USGS US Imagery") %>%
  addTiles(group = "Open Street Map")

# Add Species Layers (Alive vs Dead Subgroups)
species_list <- names(species_colors)

for (sp in species_list) {
  # Alive points
  sp_alive <- geo_data[geo_data$Common_Name == sp & tolower(geo_data$Alive_Dead) != "dead", ]
  if (nrow(sp_alive) > 0) {
    m <- m %>% addCircleMarkers(
      data = sp_alive,
      radius = 8,
      fillColor = ~fill_color,
      color = ~border_color,
      weight = 1,
      opacity = 1,
      fillOpacity = 0.8,
      popup = ~popup_html,
      group = paste(sp, "- Alive")
    )
  }
  
  # Dead points
  sp_dead <- geo_data[geo_data$Common_Name == sp & tolower(geo_data$Alive_Dead) == "dead", ]
  if (nrow(sp_dead) > 0) {
    m <- m %>% addCircleMarkers(
      data = sp_dead,
      radius = 8,
      fillColor = ~fill_color,
      color = ~border_color,
      weight = 1,
      opacity = 1,
      fillOpacity = 0.8,
      popup = ~popup_html,
      group = paste(sp, "- Dead")
    )
  }
}

# Add Layers Control & Guaranteed Toggle Handler
all_groups <- unlist(lapply(species_list, function(sp) c(paste(sp, "- Alive"), paste(sp, "- Dead"))))

m <- m %>%
  addLayersControl(
    baseGroups = c("USGS US Imagery", "Open Street Map"),
    overlayGroups = all_groups,
    options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE)
  ) %>%
  add_custom_legend() %>%
  htmlwidgets::onRender("
    function(el, x) {
      var map = this;
      
      // Use MutationObserver to wait until Leaflet injects the overlay control HTML
      var observer = new MutationObserver(function(mutations, me) {
        var container = el.querySelector('.leaflet-control-layers-overlays');
        if (container) {
          me.disconnect(); // Stop watching once found
          
          // Create master checkbox wrapper
          var toggleLabel = document.createElement('label');
          toggleLabel.style.fontWeight = 'bold';
          toggleLabel.style.paddingBottom = '6px';
          toggleLabel.style.marginBottom = '6px';
          toggleLabel.style.borderBottom = '1px solid #ccc';
          toggleLabel.style.display = 'block';
          toggleLabel.innerHTML = '<div><input type=\"checkbox\" id=\"select-all-whales\" checked> Select / Deselect All</div>';
          
          container.insertBefore(toggleLabel, container.firstChild);
          
          // Wire event listener to check/uncheck all layer boxes
          document.getElementById('select-all-whales').addEventListener('change', function(e) {
            var checked = e.target.checked;
            var checkboxes = container.querySelectorAll('input[type=\"checkbox\"]:not(#select-all-whales)');
            checkboxes.forEach(function(cb) {
              if (cb.checked !== checked) {
                cb.click();
              }
            });
          });
        }
      });
      
      observer.observe(el, { childList: true, subtree: true });
    }
  ")

m
```

```{r}
library(geojsonsf)

# Convert sf object to clean GeoJSON string for client-side JavaScript
geo_json_str <- sf_geojson(geo_data)

# Compute spatial bounding box for initial map bounds
bbox <- st_bbox(geo_data)

# Build Time Map
m_time <- leaflet(height = "800px", width = "800px") %>%
  fitBounds(
    lng1 = as.numeric(bbox["xmin"]), lat1 = as.numeric(bbox["ymin"]),
    lng2 = as.numeric(bbox["xmax"]), lat2 = as.numeric(bbox["ymax"])
  ) %>%
  addProviderTiles(providers$USGS.USImagery, group = "USGS US Imagery") %>%
  addTiles(group = "Open Street Map") %>%
  addLayersControl(
    baseGroups = c("USGS US Imagery", "Open Street Map"),
    options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE)
  ) %>%
  add_custom_legend()

# Inject client-side TimeDimension animation using GeoJSON features
m_time <- m_time %>% htmlwidgets::onRender(
  sprintf("
  function(el, x) {
    var map = this;
    var geoData = %s;

    // Custom TimeDimension Date Control for Years
    var TimeDimensionCustom = L.Control.TimeDimension.extend({
      _getDisplayDateFormat: function(date) {
        return date.getFullYear().toString();
      }
    });

    // 1. Initialize TimeDimension
    var timeDimension = new L.TimeDimension({
      period: 'P1Y',
      timeInterval: '1982-01-01T00:00:00Z/2026-01-01T00:00:00Z'
    });
    map.timeDimension = timeDimension;

    // 2. Add TimeControl
    var timeDimensionControl = new TimeDimensionCustom({
      timeSliderDragUpdate: true,
      loopButton: true,
      position: 'topleft',
      title: 'Year',
      playerOptions: { transitionTime: 1000, loop: true },
      displayDate: true,
      autoPlay: false,
      minSpeed: 1, maxSpeed: 5, speedStep: 1
    });
    map.addControl(timeDimensionControl);

    // 3. Create Base GeoJSON layer
    var baseGeoJsonLayer = L.geoJson(geoData, {
      pointToLayer: function(feature, latlng) {
        return L.circleMarker(latlng, {
          radius: 8,
          fillColor: feature.properties.fill_color || '#c2291b',
          color: feature.properties.border_color || '#ffffff',
          weight: 1,
          opacity: 1,
          fillOpacity: 0.8
        });
      },
      onEachFeature: function(feature, layer) {
        if (feature.properties && feature.properties.popup_html) {
          layer.bindPopup(feature.properties.popup_html);
        }
      }
    });

    // 4. Wrap in TimeDimension Layer (updateTimeDimension MUST be false to prevent recursion)
    var timeLayer = L.timeDimension.layer.geoJson(baseGeoJsonLayer, {
      updateTimeDimension: false,
      duration: 'P1Y',
      addlastPoint: false
    });

    timeLayer.addTo(map);
  }
  ",
  geo_json_str
  )
)

m_time
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# Color scale configuration matching original Polymer element
colors_df <- data.frame(
  name = c("> 560", "281 to 560", "141 to 280", "71 to 140", "36 to 70", "21 to 35", "< 21"),
  color = c('#d52e26', '#ec7552', '#f7b57f', '#ffffbc', '#c0cbbd', '#849eb9', '#4575b4'),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# 2. Build Base Leaflet Map
m <- leaflet(height = "800px") %>%
  setView(lng = -123, lat = 42, zoom = 6) %>%
  addProviderTiles(providers$Esri.WorldImagery, group = "Esri World Imagery") %>%
  addProviderTiles(providers$Esri.OceanBasemap, group = "Esri Ocean Basemap") %>%
  addProviderTiles(providers$Esri.WorldTopoMap, group = "Esri World TopoMap") %>%
  addLayersControl(
    baseGroups = c("Esri World Imagery", "Esri Ocean Basemap", "Esri World TopoMap"),
    options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE)
  )

# 3. Inject Client-Side shpjs + TimeDimension Logic
m <- m %>% htmlwidgets::onRender(
  sprintf("
  function(el, x) {
    var map = this;
    var mapTitle = %s;
    var shpFileName = %s;
    var colorRanges = %s;

    var shpfileUrl = 'crab_layers/' + shpFileName;

    function getColor(d) {
      return d > 560 ? colorRanges[0].color :
             d > 280 ? colorRanges[1].color :
             d > 140 ? colorRanges[2].color :
             d > 70  ? colorRanges[3].color :
             d > 35  ? colorRanges[4].color :
             d > 20  ? colorRanges[5].color :
             d > 0   ? colorRanges[6].color :
                       '#ffffff00';
    }

    // Custom TimeDimension Control (Mirrors Polymer attached() logic)
    var TimeDimensionCustom = L.Control.TimeDimension.extend({
      _getDisplayDateFormat: function(date) {
        var m = date.getMonth();
        var y = date.getFullYear().toString();
        var y2 = (parseInt(y) + 1).toString();
        var y3 = y.substr(2) + y2.substr(2);
        var mon = '', montext = '';

        switch (m) {
          case 11:
            mon = 'NF';
            montext = 'Nov ' + y + ' to Feb ' + y2;
            break;
          case 3:
            mon = 'MJ';
            montext = 'Mar ' + y + ' to Jun ' + y;
            break;
          case 7:
            mon = 'JO';
            montext = 'Jul ' + y + ' to Oct ' + y;
            break;
        }

        this.selectedtime = 'DUN_' + mon + (mon === 'NF' ? y3 : y);
        this.selectedtimetext = montext;

        if (this.layer) {
          var selTime = this.selectedtime;
          this.layer.setStyle(function(feature) {
            var val = feature.properties[selTime];
            var c = getColor(val);
            return {
              fillColor: c,
              weight: 1,
              color: c,
              fillOpacity: 0.7
            };
          });
        }

        if (this.infoDiv) {
          this.infoDiv.innerHTML = mapTitle + ' from <b>' + this.selectedtimetext + '</b>';
        }

        return y + '-' + mon;
      }
    });

    // Initialize TimeDimension
    var timeDimension = new L.TimeDimension({
      period: 'P4M',
      timeInterval: '2011-01-01T00:00:00Z/2016-09-01T00:00:00Z'
    });
    map.timeDimension = timeDimension;

    var timeDimensionControl = new TimeDimensionCustom({
      timeSliderDragUpdate: true,
      loopButton: true,
      position: 'topleft',
      title: 'Year',
      playerOptions: { transitionTime: 1000, loop: true },
      displayDate: true,
      autoPlay: false,
      minSpeed: 1, maxSpeed: 5, speedStep: 1
    });
    map.addControl(timeDimensionControl);

    // Info Control Box
    var info = L.control({ position: 'topright' });
    info.onAdd = function() {
      var div = L.DomUtil.create('div', 'info');
      timeDimensionControl.infoDiv = div;
      div.innerHTML = mapTitle + ' from <b>Nov 2010 to Feb 2011</b>';
      return div;
    };
    info.addTo(map);

    // Legend Box
    var legend = L.control({ position: 'topright' });
    legend.onAdd = function() {
      var div = L.DomUtil.create('div', 'legend');
      div.innerHTML = '<center><span class=\"dotlegend\">VMS pts</span></center><br>';
      for (var i = 0; i < colorRanges.length; i++) {
        var idx = colorRanges.length - 1 - i;
        div.innerHTML += '<div style=\"width:95%%;padding-left:3px;background-color:' + colorRanges[idx].color + '\">' + colorRanges[idx].name + '</div>';
      }
      return div;
    };
    legend.addTo(map);

    // Fetch and parse the zipped shapefile client-side using shpjs
    shp(shpfileUrl).then(function(geojson) {
      var geojsonLayer = L.geoJson(geojson, {
        onEachFeature: function(feature, layer) {
          if (feature.properties) {
            var popupContent = Object.keys(feature.properties).map(function(k) {
              var k1 = k.indexOf('DUN_') === 0 ? k.substr(4) : k;
              return k1 + ': ' + feature.properties[k];
            }).join('<br />');
            layer.bindPopup(popupContent, { maxHeight: 200 });
          }
        },
        style: function(feature) {
          var c = getColor(feature.properties['DUN_NF1011']);
          return {
            fillColor: c,
            weight: 1,
            color: c,
            fillOpacity: 0.7
          };
        }
      });

      geojsonLayer.addTo(map);
      timeDimensionControl.layer = geojsonLayer;
    }).catch(function(err) {
      console.error('Error parsing shapefile zip:', err);
    });
  }
  ",
  toJSON(maptitle, auto_unbox = TRUE),
  toJSON(shpfile_name, auto_unbox = TRUE),
  toJSON(colors_df, auto_unbox = TRUE)
  )
)

m
```
